evidence.title: Alaska approves New Amalga mine access road

occurrences.checkable_against: Alaska public-comment record for the New Amalga road easement
occurrences.quote_span: Nearly 90% of 196 public comments received earlier this year opposed the road.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Alaska DMLW easement approval and legal description
occurrences.quote_span: The private non-exclusive easement includes a 15-foot-wide gravel road and two one-acre helicopter pads on state land off Glacier Highway.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW phased easement authorization document
occurrences.quote_span: The state intends to authorize the requested road in two phases.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW easement agreement and mitigation conditions
occurrences.quote_span: DMLW states it has considered the fish and wildlife habitat in the easement, and will require a 300-foot-wide buffer along anadromous streams as a mitigation measure.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW decision dated Aug. 18, 2026 and New Amalga project access records
occurrences.quote_span: The road was approved Aug. 18 and will provide Grand Portage access for the unapproved New Amalga Gold Project near the face of Herbert Glacier on U.S. Forest Service land.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW approval and Alaska tax-revenue records
occurrences.quote_span: The approval also notes the requested road will provide direct economic benefit to the state through the Entry Authorization and Annual Use Fee. If the proposed mining project is approved, the state would receive further direct economic benefits through tax revenues.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: New Amalga project site plan and permitting documents
occurrences.quote_span: If the project moves forward, the road will lead to an approximate 30-acre surface facilities site, which is expected to host equipment shops, electrical generation, water treatment plants, ore sorting facilities and temporary rock staging pads.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW phase-one easement authorization
occurrences.quote_span: The first phase authorizes the immediate development of the 0.17-mile segment of road closest to Glacier Highway and the first one-acre helicopter staging area.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Alaska tax-revenue records and DMLW approval analysis
occurrences.quote_span: If the proposed mining project is approved, the state would receive further direct economic benefits through tax revenues.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW approval and Entry Authorization and Annual Use Fee records
occurrences.quote_span: The approval also notes the requested road will provide direct economic benefit to the state through the Entry Authorization and Annual Use Fee.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Alaska DMLW easement approval and legal description

figure.value: 15-foot-wide gravel road and two one-acre helicopter pads

occurrences.quote_span: The private non-exclusive easement includes a 15-foot-wide gravel road and two one-acre helicopter pads on state land off Glacier Highway.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water easement approval record
occurrences.quote_span: The state has approved the first segment of a mining road requested by Grand Portage Resources Ltd., a Canadian mining company.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW easement conditions and state-land access records
occurrences.quote_span: It adds that existing public access to state-owned land in the area of the proposed easement will remain open, although the applicant will be allowed to install a gate at the easement’s entrance to control vehicular access along the roadway for safety measures.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW public notice and appeals docket
occurrences.quote_span: No public comments are being sought on the public notice, but appeals are accepted until Sept. 7.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Grand Portage logistics plan and Mendenhall Valley noise assessments
occurrences.quote_span: Grand Portage stated since the mining project is currently only accessible via helicopter, the road development and staging areas will reduce the distance of supply shuttles and reduce noise impacts to residential areas in the Mendenhall Valley.
occurrences.speaker: Grand Portage Resources
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Alaska Department of Transportation and Public Facilities driveway or approach road permit records
occurrences.quote_span: A driveway or approach road permit for the turnout from Glacier Highway is expected to be obtained from the Alaska Department of Transportation and Public Facilities before development.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Grand Portage project plan and off-site processing agreements
occurrences.quote_span: Due to the resource location near tidewater and less than four miles from existing paved highway, Grand Portage plans to utilize off-site processing by a third party, according to the company.
occurrences.speaker: Grand Portage Resources
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Issued DMLW easement and standard-term policy
occurrences.quote_span: DMLW issues it for 25 years, stating it’s the standard term length.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Grand Portage Aug. 20, 2026 press release and helicopter logistics records

figure.unit: percent reduction in helicopter shuttle distance

occurrences.quote_span: “The helicopter shuttle distance for slinging equipment and supplies will be reduced by approximately 60% for each cycle compared to the previous staging area located in the Juneau Mendenhall Valley suburbs,” a company press release on Aug. 20 states.
occurrences.speaker: Grand Portage Resources
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW phase-two authorization and U.S. Forest Service production approval
occurrences.quote_span: The second phase authorizes the development of the remaining 1.13-mile road segment and staging area, once Grand Portage receives Forest Service approval to begin mineral extraction production.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Grand Portage easement application and DMLW issued easement
occurrences.quote_span: Grand Portage applied for an easement term of 35 years. DMLW issues it for 25 years, stating it’s the standard term length.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Municipal tax records, vendor contracts and employment records
occurrences.quote_span: Also, if the mining project is approved it will provide indirect economic benefits to the state through municipal property tax revenues, more business for local vendors, and job opportunities in the construction, mining and industry sectors.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: New Amalga mine project design and permit application
occurrences.quote_span: The future facilities at the proposed mining site are envisioned to include a selective underground mining operation, but are not planned to include an ore processing plant or tailings disposal landfill.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Approved easement map and recreation-trail GIS records
occurrences.quote_span: The road will stretch for approximately 1.3 miles between the Herbert Glacier and Eagle Glacier trail and does not directly intersect any of the existing recreation trails.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW easement approval decision
occurrences.quote_span: For this reason, the state acknowledges that while the road and staging areas will impact recreation in the area, it “does not agree that the wild and scenic nature of the area will be irreversibly damaged by approving this easement.”
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW easement application file and public-notice publication records
occurrences.quote_span: The easement application was first submitted last August and public notice took place from February to March.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW easement conditions and site-inspection records
occurrences.quote_span: A chain-link fence will be installed around the perimeter of each staging area, as well as solar-powered security cameras.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: Executed DMLW easement agreement and required Environmental Assessment report
occurrences.quote_span: It adds the easement agreement includes terms Grand Portage must follow to minimize the potential for spills and pollution, and a required Environmental Assessment report at the end of the easement term.
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement

occurrences.checkable_against: DMLW approval decision and Alaska land-use regulations
occurrences.quote_span: And since mining is an allowable designated use “it is reasonable to infer that development of mining roads, staging areas, and similar support infrastructure are an allowable designated use as well,” according to the state’s approval .
occurrences.speaker: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water
occurrences.subject: Alaska Division of Mining, Land and Water New Amalga mine access road easement
